title: 第0005章 南山夺药宿敌交锋第0006章 药会扬名再遇清雪
content_zh:
【第一节：夜探南山，药香引路】
夜色如墨，乌云遮蔽了月光，给青炎城南郊的南山披上了一层诡谲的阴影。
林药尘背着药篓，手持一柄磨得锋利的短铲，借着夜色的掩护，悄无声息地穿行在山林之间。药徒二重的修为虽然不算高深，但足以让他的步伐比常人轻盈许多，踩在落叶堆上也只发出极轻微的沙沙声。
他在惠民草堂查阅过南山的地形图，也向孙老头打听过南山产药的情况。南山山势平缓，多丘陵沟壑，盛产各类草药，尤其是阳坡地带，最适合仙灵脾生长。但今晚，他并不是来常规采药的。
林啸天在百草斋的对话，让他嗅到了一丝阴谋的气息。林家大量收购仙灵脾，绝不仅仅是为了炼制普通的“火燥丹”那么简单。仙灵脾主补肾阳，性燥烈，若是配合某些特殊的药物，甚至可以炼制出激发人体潜能、但副作用极大的狂暴丹药。林啸天急于求成，很可能在暗中筹备着什么见不得人的勾当。
“系统，能否感应到附近的高浓度药力波动？”林药尘在心中默问。
【正在扫描周边环境……】
【检测到东南方向三里有微弱的灵药反应，疑似仙灵脾群落。】
【警告：东南方向同时存在多股人类热源，修为均在淬体境以上，请宿主小心行事。】
林药尘心中一凛。果然有人！而且修为都不弱，至少是淬体境，比他这个药徒二重高出一截。看来林啸天派了人手在这里看守，防止别人采摘高品质的仙灵脾。
“淬体境么……”林药尘嘴角勾起一抹冷冽的笑意。若是十天前，他面对淬体境武者只有逃命的份，但现在不同了。他拥有系统的辅助，对草药的运用远超常人，未必没有一战之力。
他收敛全身气息，将《万古药尊诀》运转到极致，整个人如同鬼魅般，贴着地面和树荫，朝着系统指示的东南方向潜行而去。
越往前走，空气中的药香味越浓。那是一种混合着草木清香和淡淡腥甜的独特气味，正是仙灵脾特有的味道。而且，这股味道远比他在后山采到的那几株要浓郁醇厚得多。
穿过一片茂密的灌木丛，林药尘趴在一块大石后，向下望去。
只见下方的山坳里，竟然燃着几堆篝火。篝火旁围着七八个人，个个身穿黑色短打劲装，腰佩长刀，正是林家的护院打扮。他们神情警惕，时不时扫视着周围的黑暗。
而在篝火上方的山坡上，一片长势旺盛的仙灵脾在夜风中轻轻摇曳。那些仙灵脾叶片翠绿肥厚，边缘的细刺在火光映照下闪着寒光，根茎粗壮，一看就是年份十足的好货。
“好一片仙灵脾群落！”林药尘心中大喜。只要将这些仙灵脾采回去，配合之前的仙茅，他就能进一步修复绝脉，冲击更高的境界！
但是，那七八个林家护院是道坎。硬闯肯定不行，对方人多势众，修为又高。必须用计！
林药尘目光扫过四周，突然落在几株不起眼的蘑菇上。那是他在惠民草堂古籍上看到过的一种毒蘑菇——“鬼脸菇”，毒性不强，但研磨成粉后，气味辛辣刺鼻，能刺激呼吸道，引起强烈的喷嚏和流泪，且无解药，只能硬抗。
“有了！”林药尘眼中闪过一丝狡黠。他小心翼翼地绕到上风口，采集了一些鬼脸菇，用石头捣碎，将辛辣的粉末收集起来，包在一片大树叶里。

随后，他悄悄摸到离林家护院营地不远的一处高地，将树叶包放在一块石头下，只露出一角。
“对不住了各位，为了我的修行大业，只好委屈你们一下了。”
林药尘心中默念，猛地将石头推开，用脚狠狠一踩！
“噗——”
一股辛辣刺鼻的粉末瞬间弥漫开来，随风飘向林家护院的营地。
“阿嚏！阿嚏！咳咳咳！”
“什么东西？好辣！呛死我了！”
“有敌袭！快起来！”
营地顿时乱成一团。那些护院被呛得眼泪鼻涕横流，不停地打喷嚏咳嗽，根本睁不开眼，哪里还能维持阵型？
林药尘看准时机，如同猎豹般从山坡上冲下，直奔那片仙灵脾而去！
【第二节：巧取豪夺，药徒显威】
“大胆贼人！敢来林家地盘撒野！”一名修为较高的护院头目强忍着不适，拔刀怒喝，朝着林药尘的方向一刀劈来！
刀风凌厉，带着淬体境五重的雄厚气劲！若是之前的林药尘，这一刀足以将他劈成两半。
但此刻，林药尘眼中毫无惧色。他体内《万古药尊诀》急速运转，药徒二重的真气灌注双腿，身形如同泥鳅般一扭，险之又险地避过了刀锋。同时，他手中短铲一扬，一蓬早就准备好的、捣碎的辣椒粉迎面洒向那护院头目！
“啊——！”护院头目猝不及防，眼睛一阵剧痛，视线瞬间模糊，惨叫着捂着眼睛后退。
“好机会！”林药尘趁着众人混乱，冲到那片仙灵脾前。他没有时间一棵棵慢慢挖，而是直接将体内真气注入短铲，狠狠一铲！
“给我起！”
轰！
连同泥土和根茎，一大片仙灵脾被他连根铲起，统统丢进背后的药篓里！
“混蛋！抓住他！”其他护院终于从鬼脸菇的粉末中缓过劲来，纷纷怒吼着冲上来。

林药尘毫不恋战，背起药篓，转身就跑。他的速度发挥到极致，在山林间穿梭，竟然比那些淬体境的护院还要快上几分！
content_en:
[Section 1: Exploring Nanshan at night, the scent of medicine leads the way]
The night was as dark as ink, and dark clouds blocked the moonlight, casting an eerie shadow on the Nanshan Mountain on the southern outskirts of Qingyan City.
Lin Yaochen carried a basket of medicine on his back and held a sharpened short shovel. He walked quietly through the mountains and forests under the cover of night. Although the cultivation level of the second-level medicine disciple is not advanced, it is enough to make his steps much lighter than ordinary people, and he only makes a very slight rustling sound when he steps on the piles of fallen leaves.
He checked the topographic map of Nanshan at Huimin Caotang, and also asked Old Man Sun about the production of medicines in Nanshan. Nanshan has gentle mountains, many hills and ravines, and is rich in various kinds of medicinal herbs, especially the sunny slopes, which are most suitable for the growth of fairy spleen. But tonight, he was not here to collect medicines for a routine purpose.
Lin Xiaotian's conversation in Baicao Zhai gave him a hint of conspiracy. The Lin family's large-scale purchase of fairy spleens was not just for the purpose of refining ordinary "Huo Zao Dan". The Fairy Spleen is responsible for nourishing kidney yang and has a strong nature. If combined with some special drugs, it can even be used to refine violent elixirs that stimulate the human body's potential but have extremely side effects. Lin Xiaotian was eager for success and was probably secretly planning some shady activities.
"Can the system sense the fluctuation of high-concentration medicinal power nearby?" Lin Yaochen asked silently in his heart.
[Scanning the surrounding environment...]
[We detected a weak elixir reaction three miles southeast, suspected to be a fairy spirit spleen community. 】
[Warning: There are multiple human heat sources in the southeast direction at the same time, and their cultivation levels are all above the body tempering realm. Please be careful, host. 】
Lin Yaochen's heart trembled. Sure enough, there is someone! And his cultivation level is not weak, at least he is in the body tempering realm, which is a bit higher than his second level medicine disciple. It seems that Lin Xiaotian has sent people to guard here to prevent others from picking high-quality fairy spleens.
"Physical Tempering Realm..." A cold smile appeared at the corner of Lin Yaochen's mouth. Ten days ago, he would have had no choice but to run for his life when facing a Body Tempering Realm warrior, but it was different now. He has systematic assistance, and his use of herbs is far beyond ordinary people, so he may not be incapable of fighting.
He gathered his aura and activated the "Eternal Medicine Master Technique" to the extreme. He was like a ghost, clinging to the ground and the shade of trees, sneaking towards the southeast direction indicated by the system.
The further we go, the stronger the scent of medicine becomes in the air. It was a unique smell mixed with the fragrance of vegetation and a touch of fishy sweetness, which was the unique taste of fairy spleen. Moreover, the smell was much richer and more mellow than the ones he picked in the back mountains.
After passing through a dense bush, Lin Yaochen lay down behind a large rock and looked down.
I saw several bonfires burning in the mountain col below. There were seven or eight people surrounding the bonfire, all wearing black shorts and long knives on their waists. They were the Lin family's nursing home attire. They looked alert, scanning the darkness around them from time to time.
On the hillside above the bonfire, a vigorously growing fairy spleen swayed gently in the night wind. The leaves of those fairy spleens are green and thick, and the fine thorns on the edges shine coldly under the firelight. The roots and stems are thick, and they are definitely good products of the same vintage.
"What a community of fairy spleens!" Lin Yaochen was overjoyed. As long as he collects these fairy spleens and combines them with the curculigo from before, he can further repair the terminal veins and reach a higher realm!
However, those seven or eight Lin Family Nursing Homes were a hurdle. It's definitely not possible to break through forcefully. The opponent has a large number of people and a high level of cultivation. Must use stratagem!
Lin Yaochen's eyes swept around and suddenly fell on a few inconspicuous mushrooms. It was a poisonous mushroom he had seen in the ancient books of Huimin Cottage - the "Grimace Mushroom". It was not very toxic, but after being ground into powder, the smell was spicy and pungent. It could irritate the respiratory tract and cause strong sneezing and tears. There was no antidote, so he had to fight it.
"Yes!" Lin Yaochen's eyes flashed with a hint of cunning. He carefully walked upwind, collected some Grimace Mushrooms, crushed them with stones, collected the spicy powder, and wrapped it in a large leaf.
Subsequently,He quietly reached a high ground not far from the Lin Family Nursing Home Camp, and placed the bag of leaves under a stone, leaving only a corner exposed.
"I'm sorry everyone, for the sake of my spiritual practice, I have to aggrieve you."
Lin Yaochen thought silently in his heart, pushed the stone away suddenly, and stepped on it hard with his foot!
"Pfft——"
A pungent and pungent powder instantly filled the air and drifted in the wind towards the camp of the Lin Family Nursing Home.
"A sneeze! A sneeze! Cough cough cough!"
"What is it? It's so spicy! It chokes me to death!"
"There's an enemy attack! Get up quickly!"
The camp suddenly fell into chaos. Those nursing homes were choked with tears and runny noses, sneezing and coughing constantly, and couldn't open their eyes at all. How could they maintain their formation?
Lin Yaochen saw the right moment and rushed down the hillside like a cheetah, heading straight for the fairy spleen!
[Section 2: Taking advantage of plunder and robbery, the medicine man shows his power]
"Bold thief! How dare you come to the Lin family's territory to run wild!" A high-level nursing leader endured the discomfort, drew his sword and shouted angrily, slashing in the direction of Lin Yaochen!
The sword wind is sharp and powerful, carrying the strength of the fifth level of the body tempering realm! If it were Lin Yaochen from before, this knife would be enough to split him in half.
But at this moment, Lin Yaochen had no fear in his eyes. The "Eternal Medicine Master Technique" in his body was running rapidly, and the true energy of the second level of Medicine Disciple was poured into his legs. His body twisted like a loach, and he narrowly avoided the blade. At the same time, he raised the shovel in his hand, and a pile of crushed chili powder that had been prepared long ago was sprinkled towards the head of the nursing home!
"Ah——!" The head of the nursing home was caught off guard. His eyes hurt sharply and his vision blurred for an instant. He screamed and covered his eyes and retreated.
"Good opportunity!" Lin Yaochen took advantage of the chaos and rushed to the fairy spleen. He didn't have time to dig slowly one by one, but directly injected his inner energy into the short shovel and shoveled hard!
"Wake it up for me!"
Boom!
Along with the soil and roots, he scooped up a large piece of fairy spleen and threw it all into the medicine basket behind him!
"Asshole! Catch him!" The other guards finally recovered from the powder from the Grimace Mushroom and rushed forward with roars.
Lin Yaochen showed no interest in fighting, picked up the medicine basket, turned around and ran away. His speed was maximized, and he was able to shuttle through the mountains and forests even faster than those in the Body Tempering Realm!
